brief.name: Cable route-length comparison
brief.purpose: Two path diagrams with segment boundaries for 95 m and 105 m fictional cases
brief.learningIntent: T01/T02; units and 100 m fictional limit supplied as accessible text
brief.plannedMethod: Actual OpenAI base imagery with preserved original output; all exact labels/values in semantic UI, with manual diagrams/edits truthfully recorded

binding.alt: Two channel diagrams have the same short final lead. The lower conduit takes a longer detour.
binding.caption: Direct route: 85 m + 10 m = 95 m. Longer route: 95 m + 10 m = 105 m. The fictional maximum is 100 m inclusive. The intact 90 m + 10 m alternative also qualifies when the other checks pass.

conversion: Scale the full uncropped frame with Lanczos and encode RGB WebP at quality 88, method 6. No retouching or labels in the derivative.
